lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They say the road east whispers of wars that never truly ended.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The town where you woke keeps a watch it no longer trusts.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Yet a company is mustered all the same - six swords and a stubborn hope.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beyond the treeline, an enemy camp grows stronger by the day.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Two duties are already yours: hold the watchtower, and break the line when the road opens.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Your first contracts wait on the tavern board.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Press J on the world map to read the journey so far.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: (This tale is still being written - and can be skipped with Esc.)
